acceptance_predicates.description: Plan validation, run, and sweep reject a missing --config input.
Config/plan mismatch or stale/incompatible selection fails before result/work-root creation or provider dispatch.
An explicit live run resolves only its referenced credential and fails typed without mock, replay, provider, or model substitution.
Configured multi-agent/model/workload/repetition sweeps expand deterministically with stable resumable point identities and limits.

definition_of_done: A setup-authored config and its compiled plan can validate, run, and sweep live benchmarks without a provider-selection artifact.

outputs.description: Validated live run and sweep execution from explicit config plus plan.

gates.description: Fake and opt-in live tests prove config-plan pairing, typed preflight, bounded execution, and redaction.
